text: Kingsmoor FC empezó fuerte con dos goles rápidos de Viktor Quinlan, uno de penalti y otro tras una jugada larga con 8 pases que duró casi 27 segundos, poniendo 2-0 al equipo local [#152] [#222]. Pero Westport Albion reaccionó con una gran velocidad y pases verticales, igualando con dos goles de Rafael Delacroix en menos de 10 minutos [#401] [#553]. En la segunda mitad, Kenji Rahman puso el 3-2 para Westport, pero Kingsmoor no se rindió pese a quedarse con un jugador menos por una expulsión de Felix Barros [#983] [#1495]. Luca Iversen empató para Kingsmoor con un gol tras un pase desde la banda apenas un minuto después [#1516]. Kingsmoor dominó la posesión y usó su juego por las bandas, mientras Westport tuvo más tiros y buscó atacar rápido y directo.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in es

- Kingsmoor FC scored their second goal at 12' following a regain of possession and a controlled build-up of 8 passes over 26.7 seconds, culminating in a medium-assist from Felix Duarte to Viktor Quinlan. This reflects a pattern of retaining possession and constructing attacks through their 4-4-2 formation emphasizing wide, crossing play to create chances from open play [222].
- Westport Albion responded quickly, scoring at 22' and 30' from open play with rapid, vertical passing sequences starting from regains. The 7- and 10-pass build-ups show their direct style aligned with their 4-4-2 formation aiming to transition quickly and exploit spaces through verticality. The second goal came from a cross assist indicating use of wide areas to support direct attacks [401,553].
- Kingsmoor FC's late goal at 82' came after a regain and quick 2-pass sequence culminating in a cross assist from Mason Morales to Luca Iversen, consistent with their wide-focused crossing strategy from a 4-4-2. Despite being a man down (red card at 81'), they pressed higher and played more directly earlier in the second half to chase the game, raising their press intensity and directness [1516,1187,1495].
- Westport Albion’s style is reflected in their greater shot volume and higher shots on target with vertical passing and directness supporting quick transitions. Their tactical change at 79' to drop deeper and slow tempo shows a more defensive posture to protect the lead, reducing press intensity and line height [553,1459].

- Viktor Quinlan scored two early goals at 8' (penalty, xG 0.76) and 12' (xG 0.266) to put Kingsmoor FC ahead 2-0 [#152, #222].
- Rafael Delacroix scored twice for Westport Albion at 22' (xG 0.768) and 30' (xG 0.973) to level the match at 2-2 [#401, #553].
- Kenji Rahman equalized again for Westport Albion at 51' (xG 0.693), making it 3-2 [#983].
- Felix Barros from Kingsmoor FC received a second yellow card and was sent off at 81' with the score at 2-3 [#1494, #1495].
- Luca Iversen scored for Kingsmoor FC at 82' (xG 0.868) to tie the match 3-3 [#1516].
